subject: planner: create index with embedded analyze (#63143)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs first parent, focusing on DDL/add-index/modify-column state-machine, job metadata plumbing, and schema-change notification to stats. Change introduces job-persisted `AnalyzeState` to gate `ActionAddIndex`/`ActionModifyColumn` publish until an internal best-effort `ANALYZE TABLE` completes (controlled by new sysvar `tidb_enable_ddl_analyze` and job-carried session vars), and propagates an `Analyzed` flag through notifier events so stats handlers can skip redundant work. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in schema/metadata consistency, multi-schema-change coordination, or DDL state transitions touched here.
